question: What remedy frees a poison-afflicted person through repeated ritual bathing?
premises: A person is afflicted by poison.
One should bathe one hundred and eight times.
This bathing leads to a poison-free state.
inference: Bathing one hundred and eight times makes a poison-afflicted person free of poison.
uncertainties: Whether the bathing is accompanied by mantra recitation is implied but not stated here.
plain_english: One afflicted by poison should bathe one hundred and eight times and may become free of poison.
